decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Mechanical Ventilation & Environmental Control Equipment, 4289/M/010 Rev "A", 4289/M/009 Rev "A", 4289/M/003 Rev "A", 4289/M/002 Rev "A", 4289/M/001 Rev "A", 0000/2016/G213/16-0025 Revision L,  Assessment of Fixed Plant Equipment Noise 1716685. Received 07/11/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposals contained within the submitted Mechanical Ventilation & Environmental Control Equipment and Assessment of Fixed Plant Equipment Noise 1716685 reports shall be installed as specified prior to the commencement of the approved use and permanently retained thereafter.
description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans) & 3 (ventilation equipment) to allow minor amendments to the proposed plant to the flat roof and the rear elevations of the building of planning permission of 00610/172/P10 for the change of use of vacant retail unit to mixed a3/a5 (restaurant and hot food take-away) installation of replacement shopfront, creation of new rear basement, installation of plant including extraction system and uncovered plant enclosure at first floor level to rear of building.
